title.zh: 卷一百〇五 列傳第五十五: 宇文融 韋堅 楊慎矜 王鉷
title.en: Volume 105 Biographies 55: Yu Wenrong, Wei Jian, Yang Shenjin, Wang Hong
title.raw: 卷一百〇五 列傳第五十五: 宇文融 韋堅 楊慎矜 王鉷 Volume 105 Biographies 55: Yu Wenrong, Wei Jian, Yang Shenjin, Wang Hong

sentences.zh: 宇文融，京兆萬年人，隋禮部尚書平昌公弼之玄孫也。

translations.literal: Yu Wenrong was a native of Wannian in Jingzhao, the great-great-grandson of Bi, Duke of Pingchang and Minister of Rites of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wenrong came from Wannian in Jingzhao. He was the great-great-grandson of Bi, Duke of Pingchang, who had served Sui as Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 祖節，貞觀中為尚書右丞，明習法令，以幹局見稱。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jie, in the Zhenguan era served as Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was well versed in laws and ordinances, and was acclaimed for administrative competence.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jie served as Right Vice Director of the Secretariat during the Zhenguan era. Well versed in law and noted for administrative skill, he won wide respect.

sentences.zh: 時江夏王道宗嘗以私事托於節，節遂奏之，太宗大悅，賜絹二百匹，仍勞之曰：「朕所以不置左右僕射者，正以卿在省耳。」

translations.literal: At the time Prince of Jiangxia Li Daozong once entrusted Jie with a private matter; Jie thereupon memorialized it. Taizong was greatly pleased, granted him two hundred bolts of silk, and consoled him, saying: "The reason I do not appoint Left and Right Vice Directors is precisely because you are in the Secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: Once Prince of Jiangxia Li Daozong asked Jie to handle a private matter, and Jie reported it to the throne. Emperor Taizong was delighted, granted him two hundred bolts of silk, and told him, "The reason I have not appointed Left and Right Vice Directors is that you are already here in the Secretariat."

sentences.zh: 永徽初，累遷黃門侍郎、同中書門下三品，代于志寧為侍中。

translations.literal: In the early Yonghui era he was repeatedly promoted to Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Third-Rank Associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and replaced Yu Zhining as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Yonghui reign he rose through repeated promotions to Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Third-Rank Associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and succeeded Yu Zhining as Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 坐房遺愛事配流桂州而卒。

translations.literal: He was implicated in the Fang Yiai affair, sentenced to exile in Guizhou, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: Implicated in the Fang Yiai affair, he was exiled to Guizhou, where he died.

sentences.zh: 父嶠，萊州長史。

translations.literal: His father Qiao was Long-term Administrator of Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qiao served as long-term administrator of Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 融，開元初累轉富平主簿，明辯有吏幹，源乾曜、孟溫相次為京兆尹，皆厚禮之，俄拜監察御史。

translations.literal: Rong, in the early Kaiyuan era was repeatedly transferred and promoted to Chief Clerk of Fuping. He was clear in argument and possessed administrative talent. Yuan Qianyao and Meng Wen successively served as Prefect of Jingzhao, and both treated him with great courtesy. Soon he was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kaiyuan era Rong rose through several posts to chief clerk of Fuping. Clear-spoken and capable as an administrator, he was warmly received by Yuan Qianyao and Meng Wen when each served in turn as prefect of Jingzhao. He was soon appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 時天下戶口逃亡，免役多偽濫，朝廷深以為患。

translations.literal: At the time households throughout the realm were fleeing registration, and exemptions from corvée were widely falsified and abused; the court deeply regarded this as a affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the empire registered households were fleeing, and corvée exemptions were widely falsified. The court regarded the problem as grave.

sentences.zh: 融乃陳便宜，奏請檢察偽濫，搜括逃戶。

translations.literal: Rong thereupon set forth advantageous measures and memorialized requesting inspection of falsifications and abuses and a search to register fugitive households.
translations.idiomatic: Rong proposed a practical remedy and memorialized the throne to inspect falsified exemptions and register fugitive households.

sentences.zh: 玄宗納其言，因令融充使推勾。

translations.literal: Xuanzong accepted his words and thereupon ordered Rong to serve as commissioner to investigate and verify.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong accepted the proposal and appointed Rong commissioner to investigate and verify the registers.

sentences.zh: 無幾，獲偽濫及諸免役甚眾，特加朝散大夫，再遷兵部員外郎，兼侍御史。

translations.literal: Before long, very many falsifications, abuses, and various exemptions from corvée were uncovered. He was specially promoted to Grand Master of Palace Leisure, then again transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of War, concurrently serving as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Within a short time he uncovered large numbers of falsified exemptions and other abuses. He received a special promotion to Grand Master of Palace Leisure, then moved up to vice director of the Ministry of War while retaining his post as attending censor.

sentences.zh: 融於是奏置勸農判官十人，並攝御史，分往天下，所在檢括田疇，招攜戶口。

translations.literal: Rong thereupon memorialized to establish ten agricultural encouragement assistant officials, all additionally acting as censors, dispatched separately throughout the realm to inspect and register fields wherever they went and to summon and settle households.
translations.idiomatic: Rong then memorialized for ten agricultural encouragement assistant officials, each also acting as censor, to be sent throughout the empire to inspect fields and register households.

sentences.zh: 其新附客戶，則免其六年賦調，但輕稅入官。

translations.literal: As for newly attached client households, they were exempted from six years of tax and corvée levies, but only lightly taxed for entry into government coffers.
translations.idiomatic: Newly attached client households were exempted from six years of tax and corvée, paying only a light levy into the government.

sentences.zh: 議者頗以為擾人不便，陽翟尉皇甫憬上疏曰：

translations.literal: Critics widely regarded this as disturbing the people and inconvenient; Huangfu Jing, magistrate of Yangdi, submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Many critics argued that the policy disturbed the people. Huangfu Jing, magistrate of Yangdi, submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 左拾遺楊相如上書，咸陳括客為不便。

translations.literal: Left Reminder Yang Xiangru submitted a memorial, all stating that registering client households was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Left Reminder Yang Xiangru also submitted a memorial, both men arguing that registering client households was harmful.

sentences.zh: 上方委任融，侍中源乾曜及中書舍人陸堅皆贊成其事，乃貶憬為盈川尉。

translations.literal: The emperor was then entrusting Rong; Palace Attendant Yuan Qianyao and Drafting Secretary Lu Jian all approved the matter, and Jing was demoted to magistrate of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then relying heavily on Rong. Palace Attendant Yuan Qianyao and drafting secretary Lu Jian supported the policy, and Huangfu Jing was demoted to magistrate of Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 於是諸道括得客戶凡八十餘萬，田亦稱是。

translations.literal: Thereupon the various circuits registered client households totaling more than eight hundred thousand; fields were likewise reported in comparable numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The various circuits eventually registered more than eight hundred thousand client households, with comparable amounts of land reported as well.

sentences.zh: 州縣希融旨意，務於獲多，皆虛張其數，亦有以實戶為客者。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties, hoping to please Rong's intent, strove to obtain as many as possible, all inflated their numbers, and some even treated genuine households as client households.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties, eager to please Rong, competed to inflate their totals. Some even reclassified genuine households as client households.

sentences.zh: 歲終征得客戶錢數百萬，融由是擢拜御史中丞。

translations.literal: By year's end several million in client-household money was collected; because of this Rong was promoted and appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: By year's end several million in client-household levies had been collected, and Rong was promoted to vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 言事者猶稱括客損居人，上令集百僚於尚書省議。

translations.literal: Memorialists still said that registering client households harmed resident households. The emperor ordered the hundred officials assembled at the Ministry of Revenue to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Critics still argued that registering client households harmed established residents. The emperor ordered the officials gathered at the Ministry of Revenue to debate the policy.

sentences.zh: 公卿已下懼融恩勢，皆雷同不敢有異詞，唯戶部侍郎楊瑒獨建議以括客不利居人，征籍外田稅，使百姓困弊，所得不補所失。

translations.literal: From the high ministers downward all feared Rong's favor and power, and all chimed in without daring dissent; only Vice Minister of Revenue Yang Chang alone submitted a proposal that registering client households was not beneficial to resident households, that levying taxes on fields outside the registers made the common people exhausted and impoverished, and that what was gained did not compensate for what was lost.
translations.idiomatic: From the highest ministers down, officials feared Rong's influence and echoed approval without dissent. Only Vice Minister of Revenue Yang Chang argued that registering client households harmed resident households, that taxing unregistered land exhausted the people, and that the gains did not offset the losses.

sentences.zh: 無幾，瑒出為外職。

translations.literal: Before long, Chang was sent out to an external post.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yang Chang was transferred to an outside post.

sentences.zh: 融乃馳傳巡歷天下，事無大小，先牒上勸農使而後申中書，省司亦待融指捴而後決斷。

translations.literal: Rong thereupon traveled by post relay throughout the realm. Matters great and small were first reported up to the agricultural encouragement commissioner and only afterward submitted to the Secretariat; the provincial offices also waited for Rong's direction before deciding.
translations.idiomatic: Rong then toured the empire by post relay. Every matter, large or small, went first to the agricultural encouragement commissioner and only then to the Secretariat; provincial offices waited for his instructions before acting.

sentences.zh: 融之所至，必招集老幼宣上恩命，百姓感其心，至有流淚稱父母者。

translations.literal: Wherever Rong arrived, he always gathered old and young to proclaim the emperor's gracious command; the common people were moved by his sincerity, and some even wept and called him father and mother.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever Rong went he gathered old and young to proclaim the emperor's decree. Moved by his sincerity, some common people wept and called him their father and mother.

sentences.zh: 融使還具奏，乃下制曰：「

translations.literal: When Rong returned from his mission and submitted a full report, an edict was thereupon issued, saying: "
translations.idiomatic: When Rong returned and submitted his full report, the emperor issued an edict: "

sentences.zh: 夫食為人天，富而後教，經教彜體，前哲至言。

translations.literal: Food is humanity's heaven; after wealth comes instruction. The canonical teaching of constant norms is the supreme saying of former sages.
translations.idiomatic: Food sustains humanity; only after people are secure can they be taught. The canonical norms handed down by the sages express this truth at its deepest.

sentences.zh: 故平糴行於昔王，義倉加於近代，所以存九年之蓄，收上中之斂。

translations.literal: Thus equitable grain purchase was practiced by kings of old, and charity granaries were added in recent times, thereby storing up nine years' reserves and collecting levies of upper and middle quality.
translations.idiomatic: Kings of old practiced equitable grain purchase; recent dynasties added charity granaries to store nine years' reserves and gather taxes of the better grades.

sentences.zh: 穰賤則農不傷財，災饉則時無菜色，救人活國，其利博哉！

translations.literal: When grain is abundant and cheap, farmers are not harmed in their wealth; when disaster and famine come, the times are without faces of vegetable green—saving people and reviving the state, how broad are its benefits!
translations.idiomatic: When grain is plentiful and cheap, farmers are not ruined; when famine strikes, no one need go hungry. To save the people and sustain the state—what greater benefit is there?

sentences.zh: 今流戶大來，王田載理，敖庾之務，寤寐所懷。

translations.literal: Now fugitive households are coming in great numbers, royal fields are being put in order, and the task of filling granaries is what We ponder waking and sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: Now fugitive households are returning in great numbers, royal fields are being brought under order, and filling the granaries is ever on Our mind.

sentences.zh: 其客戶所稅錢，宜均充所在常平倉用，仍許預付價值，任粟麥兼貯。

translations.literal: The money levied from client households should uniformly be applied to the ever-normal granaries of each locality, and advance payment of value is still permitted, allowing both grain and wheat to be stored together.
translations.idiomatic: Tax money collected from client households should be used for local ever-normal granaries, with advance payment permitted and both millet and wheat allowed in storage.

sentences.zh: 並舊常平錢粟，並委本道判官勾當處置，使斂散及時，務以矜恤。

translations.literal: Together with the old ever-normal money and grain, all are to be entrusted to the circuit assistant officials for handling and disposal, so that collection and distribution are timely and care is taken to show compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Existing ever-normal funds and grain, together with the new levies, are to be managed by circuit assistant officials so that collection and release are timely and the people treated with care.

sentences.zh: 且分災恤患，州黨之常情；

translations.literal: Moreover, sharing disaster and relieving affliction is the constant feeling of district and community;
translations.idiomatic: Sharing disaster and relieving distress is the ordinary duty of community and neighborhood;

sentences.zh: 損餘濟闕，親鄰之善貸。

translations.literal: diminishing surplus to aid deficiency is the good lending of kin and neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: using surplus to help those in need is the proper kindness among kin and neighbors.

sentences.zh: 故木鐸云徇，里胥均功，夜績相從，齊俗以贍。

translations.literal: Therefore the wooden clapper proclaimed the law, village clerks equalized labor, night spinning went together, and the customs of Qi were thereby sustained.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the wooden clapper proclaimed the law, village clerks apportioned labor, neighbors spun together at night, and communities thereby sustained one another.

sentences.zh: 今陽和布澤，丁壯就田，言念鰥煢，事資拯助。

translations.literal: Now the warm yang spreads its grace, strong young men go to the fields, and when We think of the widowed and orphaned, the matter calls for rescue and aid.
translations.idiomatic: Now as spring spreads its blessings and able-bodied men return to the fields, We think of widows and orphans and know they need help.

sentences.zh: 宜委使司與州縣商量，勸作農社，貧富相恤，耕耘以時。

translations.literal: It is fitting to commission the dispatch offices and prefectures and counties to consult together, encourage the formation of agricultural associations, have rich and poor support one another, and plow and sow at the proper season.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch offices and local officials should consult together, encourage agricultural associations, have rich and poor support one another, and see that planting is done in season.

sentences.zh: 仍每至雨澤之後，種獲忙月，州縣常務，一切停減。

translations.literal: Moreover, whenever after rains and grace the busy months of planting and harvest come, the regular duties of prefectures and counties are all to be suspended and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the rains come and the busy seasons of planting and harvest arrive, the ordinary duties of prefectures and counties should all be reduced.

sentences.zh: 使趨時急於備寇，尺璧賤於寸陰，是則天無虛施，人無遺力。

translations.literal: Make hurrying at the proper season more urgent than preparing against invaders; make a foot of jade cheaper than an inch of shadow—then Heaven will have nothing wasted in bestowal, and men will have no strength left unused.
translations.idiomatic: Let timely work be more urgent than defense against invasion; let a foot of jade be valued less than an inch of daylight—then Heaven's gifts will not be wasted and no labor will be lost.

sentences.zh: 又政在經遠，功惟久著，今逃亡初復，居業未康，循逃戶及籍外剩田，猶宜勞徠，理資存撫。

translations.literal: Moreover, government lies in long-range planning, and achievement is shown only over time. Now that fugitives are first returning and settled livelihoods are not yet secure, continuing with fugitive households and surplus fields outside the registers still calls for labor to attract and settle them, and governance requires preservation and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Government must look to the long term and prove itself over time. Fugitives are only now returning and livelihoods are not yet secure; fugitive households and unregistered surplus land still require effort to attract settlers and steady governance to support them.

sentences.zh: 其十道分判官，三五年內，使就厥功，令有終始。

translations.literal: The ten-circuit assistant officials, within three to five years, should be made to complete their work and given a clear beginning and end.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant officials of the ten circuits should, within three to five years, be required to complete their work with a clear beginning and end.

sentences.zh: 當道覆屯，及須推劾，並以委之，不須廣差餘使，示專其事，不擾於人。

translations.literal: Circuit review of garrison farms, and matters requiring investigation and impeachment, are all to be entrusted to them; there is no need broadly to dispatch additional commissioners, thereby showing exclusive charge of the matter and not disturbing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit review of garrison farms and matters requiring investigation should all be entrusted to them. No additional commissioners need be sent, so that responsibility is clear and the people are not disturbed.

sentences.zh: 政術有能，必行賞罰。

translations.literal: Where administrative methods show ability, rewards and punishments must be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Where officials prove capable, rewards and punishments must follow.

sentences.zh: 其已奏復業歸首，勾當州縣，每季一申，不須挾名，致有勞擾。

translations.literal: For those already reported as having resumed occupation and surrendered, the handling prefectures and counties shall report once each season; names need not be appended, lest there be troublesome harassment.
translations.idiomatic: For households already reported as having resumed occupation and surrendered, handling prefectures and counties should report quarterly without attaching names, so as to avoid harassment.

sentences.zh: 其歸首戶，各令新首處與本貫計會年戶色役，勿欺隱及其兩處征科。

translations.literal: For surrendering households, each is to have the place of new surrender coordinate with the original domicile in reckoning annual household corvée and tax duties, and there must be no concealment causing double collection at both places.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendering households must have their new place of registration coordinate with their original domicile in reckoning annual household taxes and corvée, with no concealment leading to double collection.

sentences.zh: 宣布天下，使明知朕意。」

translations.literal: Proclaim this throughout the realm, that all may clearly know Our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim this throughout the realm so that all may clearly know Our intent."

sentences.zh: 中書令張說素惡融之為人，又患其權重，融之所奏，多建議爭之。

translations.literal: Chief Minister of the Secretariat Zhang Yue had long disliked Rong's character and also feared his heavy authority; what Rong memorialized, Yue mostly disputed in deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Zhang Yue had long disliked Rong's character and feared his power. He contested most of what Rong proposed.

sentences.zh: 融揣其意，先事圖之。

translations.literal: Rong divined his intent and plotted against him beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Rong guessed his intentions and moved against him first.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人張九齡言於說曰：「宇文融承恩用事，辯給多詞，不可不備也。」

translations.literal: Drafting Secretary Zhang Jiuling spoke to Yue, saying: "Yu Wenrong, favored with grace, wields power; he is eloquent and wordy—he must not go unguarded against."
translations.idiomatic: Drafting secretary Zhang Jiuling told Yue, "Yu Wenrong enjoys imperial favor and wields power. He is eloquent and slippery—you must guard against him."

sentences.zh: 說曰：「此狗鼠輩，焉能為事！」

translations.literal: Yue said: 'These dog-and-rat fellows—what can they accomplish!'"
translations.idiomatic: Yue replied, 'Those dog-and-rat creatures—what can they do!'"

sentences.zh: 融尋兼戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Rong was soon additionally appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Rong was additionally appointed vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 從東封還，又密陳意見，分吏部為十銓典選事，所奏又為說所抑。

translations.literal: Returning from the eastern feng and shan rites, he again secretly submitted his views, dividing the Ministry of Personnel into ten selection boards to handle appointment affairs; what he memorialized was again suppressed by Yue.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from the eastern feng and shan rites, he again submitted secret proposals to divide the Ministry of Personnel into ten selection boards. Yue blocked that memorial as well.

sentences.zh: 融乃與御史大夫崔隱甫連名劾說，廷奏其狀，說由是罷知政事。

translations.literal: Rong thereupon jointly with Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Yinpu impeached Yue by signed memorial, presenting the case at court; because of this Yue was removed from participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Rong then joined Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Yinpu in impeaching Yue. They presented the case at court, and Yue was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 融恐說復用為己患，數譖毀之。

translations.literal: Rong feared that if Yue were reused it would become a trouble to himself, and repeatedly slandered and defamed him.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing Yue might return to power, Rong repeatedly slandered him.

sentences.zh: 上惡其朋黨，尋出融為魏州刺史。

translations.literal: The emperor disliked their factionalism and soon sent Rong out as Prefect of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor disliked their factional scheming and soon transferred Rong to prefect of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 俄轉汴州刺史，又上表請用《禹貢》九河舊道，開稻田以利人，並回易陸運本錢，官收其利。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Prefect of Bianzhou, and again submitted a memorial requesting use of the old course of the Nine Rivers in the Tribute of Yu, opening paddy fields to benefit the people, and also converting overland transport capital, with the government collecting the profit.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to prefect of Bianzhou and memorialized to reopen the old course of the Nine Rivers described in the Tribute of Yu, develop paddy fields for the people's benefit, and convert overland transport capital so the state could take the profit.

sentences.zh: 雖興役不息，而事多不就。

translations.literal: Although corvée labor was raised without cease, most of the projects were not completed.
translations.idiomatic: Though corvée labor never ceased, most of the projects came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 十六年，復入為鴻臚卿，兼戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he again entered court as Minister of Ceremonial and concurrently Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he returned to court as minister of ceremonial and concurrent vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜黃門侍郎，與裴光庭並兼同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Vice Director of the Yellow Gate, and together with Pei Guangting was concurrently made Associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the Same Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed vice director of the Yellow Gate and, together with Pei Guangting, was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the same rank.

sentences.zh: 融既居相位，欲以天下為己任，謂人曰：「使吾居此數月，庶令海內無事矣。」

translations.literal: Once Rong had taken the chief ministership, he wished to take the realm as his own responsibility, and said to people: "If I hold this post for several months, I hope to make the realm within the seas free of trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Once in the chief ministership, Rong wished to take the empire as his charge and told others, "Give me a few months in this post and I shall leave the realm at peace."

sentences.zh: 於是薦宋璟為右丞相，裴耀卿為戶部侍郎，許景先為工部侍郎，甚允朝廷之望。

translations.literal: Thereupon he recommended Song Jing as Right Chief Minister, Pei Yaoqing as Vice Minister of Revenue, and Xu Jingxian as Vice Minister of Works—greatly meeting the court's expectations.
translations.idiomatic: He then recommended Song Jing as right chief minister, Pei Yaoqing as vice minister of revenue, and Xu Jingxian as vice minister of works—appointments that greatly satisfied the court.

sentences.zh: 然性躁急多言，又引賓客故人，晨夕飲謔，由是為時論所譏。

translations.literal: Yet his nature was impetuous, urgent, and talkative; he also invited guests and old associates, drinking and jesting morning and evening—whereby he was ridiculed in contemporary opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was impetuous, talkative, and fond of entertaining guests and old friends morning and night, and contemporary opinion mocked him for it.

sentences.zh: 時禮部尚書、信安王祎為朔方節度使，殿中侍御史李宙劾之，驛召將下獄。

translations.literal: At the time Minister of Rites and Prince of Xin'an Li Xin served as military governor of Shuofang; Palace Attendant Li Zhou impeached him, and by post relay he was summoned and about to be imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Minister of Rites Prince of Xin'an Li Xin served as military governor of Shuofang. Palace Attendant Li Zhou impeached him, and he was summoned by urgent relay to be imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 祎既申訴得理，融坐阿黨李宙，出為汝州刺史，在相凡百日而罷。

translations.literal: Once Xin had pleaded his case and was found in the right, Rong was punished for partisan support of Li Zhou and sent out as Prefect of Ruzhou; in the chief ministership he totaled only a hundred days before dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Xin successfully defended himself, Rong was punished for supporting Li Zhou and sent out as prefect of Ruzhou. He had held the chief ministership only a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 裴光庭時兼御史大夫，又彈融交遊朋黨及男受贓等事，貶昭州平樂尉。

translations.literal: Pei Guangting then concurrently served as Vice Censor-in-Chief and again impeached Rong for factional association and for his son receiving bribes and other matters; he was demoted to Commandant of Pingle in Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Guangting, then also vice censor-in-chief, impeached Rong again for factional ties and for his son accepting bribes. Rong was demoted to commandant of Pingle in Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 在嶺外歲餘，司農少卿蔣岑舉奏融在汴州回造船腳，隱沒鉅萬，給事中馮紹烈又深文案其事實，融於是配流巖州。

translations.literal: After more than a year beyond the ranges, Vice Minister of Agriculture Jiang Cen memorialized that Rong, while in Bianzhou, had diverted ship-transport fees in building boats and concealed tens of thousands; Drafting Secretary Feng Shaolie again deeply investigated the facts of the case in documents, and Rong was thereupon sentenced to exile in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year in the south, Vice Minister of Agriculture Jiang Cen reported that Rong had diverted ship-transport fees while in Bianzhou and concealed tens of thousands. Drafting secretary Feng Shaolie investigated the case in detail, and Rong was exiled to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 地既瘴毒，憂恚發疾，遂詣廣府，將停留未還。

translations.literal: The place being malarial and poisonous, worry and resentment brought on illness; he thereupon went to the Guang prefecture, intending to linger and not return.
translations.idiomatic: The region was malarial, and grief and resentment brought on illness. He went to Guang prefecture intending to linger there rather than continue into exile.

sentences.zh: 都督耿仁忠謂融曰：「明公負朝廷深譴，以至於此，更欲故犯嚴命，淹留他境，仁忠見累，誠所甘心，亦恐朝廷知明公在此，必不相容也。」

translations.literal: Protector-general Geng Renzhong said to Rong: "Your Grace bears the court's heavy punishment and have come to this. If you again deliberately violate the stern command and linger in another region, Renzhong will be implicated—I would truly accept that willingly—but I also fear that if the court learns Your Grace is here, it will certainly not tolerate it."
translations.idiomatic: Protector-general Geng Renzhong told Rong, "You bear the court's heavy punishment and have come to this. If you deliberately violate the imperial order and linger in another jurisdiction, I shall be implicated—and I would accept that—but I fear the court will not tolerate your remaining here."

sentences.zh: 融遽還，卒於路。

translations.literal: Rong hurriedly returned and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Rong hurried back but died on the road.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，思其舊功，贈臺州刺史。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he recalled his old service and posthumously granted him Prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he remembered Rong's earlier service and posthumously granted him prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 韋堅，京兆萬年人。

translations.literal: Wei Jian was a native of Wannian in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian came from Wannian in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 父元珪，先天中，銀青光祿大夫，開元初，袞州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Yuangui, in the Xiantian era was Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace, and in the early Kaiyuan era was Prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yuangui held the rank of Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace in the Xiantian era and served as prefect of Yanzhou in the early Kaiyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 堅姊為贈惠宣太子妃，堅妻又楚國公姜皎女，堅妹又為皇太子妃，中外榮盛，故早從官敘。

translations.literal: Jian's elder sister was posthumously honored Consort of the Heir Apparent of Huixuan; Jian's wife was again a daughter of Duke of Chu Jiang Jiao; Jian's younger sister was again consort of the Crown Prince—inside and outside the family were gloriously eminent, and therefore he early entered official ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Jian's elder sister had been consort to the posthumously honored Heir Apparent of Huixuan; his wife was a daughter of Duke of Chu Jiang Jiao; his younger sister was consort to the crown prince. With such connections inside and outside the family, he entered official service early.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，為長安令，以幹濟聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he served as Magistrate of Chang'an and was known for administrative efficiency.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he became magistrate of Chang'an and was known for administrative efficiency.

sentences.zh: 與中貴人善，探候主意。

translations.literal: He was on good terms with palace favorites and probed the emperor's intentions.
translations.idiomatic: He cultivated ties with palace favorites and watched the emperor's intentions closely.

sentences.zh: 見宇文融楊慎矜父子以勾剝財物爭行進奉而致恩顧，堅乃以轉運江淮租賦，所在置吏督察，以裨國之倉廩，歲益鉅萬。

translations.literal: Seeing Yu Wenrong and Yang Shenjin, father and son, compete in presenting goods seized and scraped together to gain imperial favor, Jian thereupon transported Jiang-Huai rent and tax levies, placing officials everywhere to supervise and inspect, thereby supplementing the state's granaries—each year increasing by tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Yu Wenrong and Yang Shenjin and his son compete to squeeze wealth from the people and present it to the throne, Jian took charge of transporting Jiang-Huai rent and tax levies, posting officials throughout to supervise collection and thereby fill the state granaries by tens of thousands each year.

sentences.zh: 玄宗以為能。

translations.literal: Xuanzong regarded him as capable.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong regarded him as capable.

sentences.zh: 堅跪上諸郡輕貨，又上百牙盤食，府縣進奏，教坊出樂叠奏。

translations.literal: Jian knelt and presented light goods from the various prefectures, again presented a hundred tooth-tray dishes of food; prefectures and counties submitted memorials, and the Music Bureau sent out musicians in layered performance.
translations.idiomatic: Jian knelt and presented light goods from the prefectures, then a hundred tooth-tray dishes of food. Prefectures and counties submitted memorials while the Music Bureau sent out musicians in layered performance.

sentences.zh: 玄宗歡悅，下詔敕曰：

translations.literal: Xuanzong was delighted and issued an edict, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Delighted, Xuanzong issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 時堅姊故惠宣太子妃亦出寶物供樓上鋪設，進食竟日而罷。

translations.literal: At the time Jian's elder sister, the former Consort of the Heir Apparent of Huixuan, also produced treasures to supply the upper hall's furnishings; the feast continued all day before ending.
translations.idiomatic: Jian's elder sister, the former consort of the Heir Apparent of Huixuan, also supplied treasures to furnish the upper hall. The feast lasted all day.

sentences.zh: 李林甫以堅姜氏婿，甚狎之。

translations.literal: Li Linfu, because Jian was Jiang's son-in-law, was very familiar with him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Linfu was very familiar with Jian, who was Jiang Jiao's son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 至是懼其詭計求進，承恩日深，堅又與李適之善，益怒之，恐入為相，乃與腹心構成其罪。

translations.literal: At this time he feared Jian's crafty schemes to seek advancement; as imperial favor grew daily deeper, Jian was again on good terms with Li Shizhi—Linfu grew still angrier, fearing Jian would enter court as chief minister, and thereupon with trusted followers fabricated his crime.
translations.idiomatic: But he now feared Jian's scheming for advancement. As imperial favor deepened and Jian grew close to Li Shizhi, Linfu grew angrier still, fearing Jian might become chief minister, and with trusted followers fabricated charges against him.

sentences.zh: 四月，進銀青光祿大夫、左散騎常侍、陜郡太守、水陸轉運使，勾當緣河及江淮南租庸轉運處置使並如故；

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was promoted to Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace, Left Regular Attendant, Prefect of Shaan Commandery, Commissioner of Water and Land Transport, and Commissioner for Handling Rent, Corvée, and Transport along the Yellow River and south of the Jiang-Huai—all as before;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Jian was promoted to Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace, left regular attendant, prefect of Shaan Commandery, and commissioner of water and land transport, retaining his posts handling rent, corvée, and transport along the Yellow River and south of the Jiang-Huai.

sentences.zh: 又以判官元捴、豆盧友除監察御史。

translations.literal: His assistant officials Yuan Cong and Doulu You were additionally appointed Investigating Censors.
translations.idiomatic: His assistant officials Yuan Cong and Doulu You were additionally appointed investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，堅又加兼御史中丞，封韋城男。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Jian was again additionally made Vice Censor-in-Chief and enfeoffed as Baron of Weicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year he was additionally made vice censor-in-chief and enfeoffed as Baron of Weicheng.

sentences.zh: 九月，拜守刑部尚書，奪諸使，以楊慎矜代之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was appointed Acting Minister of Justice, stripped of his various commissioner posts, and Yang Shenjin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was appointed acting minister of justice, stripped of his commissioner posts, and replaced by Yang Shenjin.

sentences.zh: 五載正月望夜，堅與河西節度、鴻臚卿皇甫惟明夜遊，同過景龍觀道士房，為林甫所發，以堅戚裏，不合與節將狎暱，是構謀規立太子。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth-night of the first month of the fifth year, Jian and Military Governor of Hexi and Minister of Ceremonial Huangfu Weiming went out at night together, passing through the Daoist chambers of Jinglong Temple; this was exposed by Linfu. Because Jian was an imperial relative by marriage, it was improper for him to be intimate with a frontier general—this was construed as plotting to install the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the lantern-night of the first month of the fifth year, Jian and Huangfu Weiming, military governor of Hexi and minister of ceremonial, went out together at night and passed through the Daoist chambers of Jinglong Temple. Linfu exposed the visit. As an imperial relative by marriage, Jian should not have been intimate with a frontier general; Linfu framed this as a plot to install the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 玄宗惑其言，遽貶堅為縉雲太守，惟明為播川太守。

translations.literal: Xuanzong was misled by his words and hastily demoted Jian to Prefect of Jinyun and Weiming to Prefect of Bochuan.
translations.idiomatic: Misled, Xuanzong hastily demoted Jian to prefect of Jinyun and Weiming to prefect of Bochuan.

sentences.zh: 尋發使殺惟明於黔中，籍其資財。

translations.literal: Soon an envoy was sent to kill Weiming in Qianzhong and confiscate his property.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an envoy was sent to kill Weiming in Qianzhong and confiscate his property.

sentences.zh: 六月，又貶堅為江夏員外別駕。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Jian was again demoted to Supernumerary Vice Prefect of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Jian was again demoted to supernumerary vice prefect of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 又構堅與李適之善，貶適之為宜春太守。

translations.literal: Again fabricating Jian's friendship with Li Shizhi, Shizhi was demoted to Prefect of Yichun.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu again used Jian's friendship with Li Shizhi against him and had Shizhi demoted to prefect of Yichun.

sentences.zh: 七月，堅又長流嶺南臨封郡，堅弟將作少匠蘭、鄠縣令冰、兵部員外郎芝、堅男河南府戶曹諒並遠貶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Jian was again sentenced to long exile in Linchuan Commandery in Lingnan; Jian's younger brothers Director of Palace Construction Lan, Magistrate of Huo County Bing, Vice Director of the Ministry of War Zhi, and Jian's son Registrar of the Henan Prefecture Revenue Office Liang were all far demoted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Jian was sentenced to long exile in Linchuan Commandery in Lingnan. His younger brothers Lan, director of palace construction; Bing, magistrate of Huo County; Zhi, vice director of the Ministry of War; and his son Liang, registrar of the Henan prefecture revenue office, were all exiled far away.

sentences.zh: 至十月，使監察御史羅希奭逐而殺之，諸弟及男諒並死。

translations.literal: By the tenth month the Investigating Censor Luo Xi'yi was sent to pursue and kill him; all the younger brothers and the son Liang also died.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month investigating censor Luo Xi'yi was sent to pursue and kill him. All the younger brothers and his son Liang also died.

sentences.zh: 堅妻姜氏，林甫以其久遭輕賤，特放還本宗。

translations.literal: Jian's wife, the Jiang clan—Linfu, because she had long suffered contempt and degradation, specially released her to return to her original clan.
translations.idiomatic: Jian's wife, of the Jiang clan, had long suffered humiliation. Linfu specially allowed her to return to her original clan.

sentences.zh: 倉部員外郎鄭章貶南豐丞，殿中侍御史鄭欽說貶夜郎尉，監察御史豆盧友貶富水尉，監察御史楊惠貶巴東尉，連累者數十人。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Zheng Zhang was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Nanfeng; Palace Attendant Zheng Qinshuo was demoted to Magistrate of Yelang; Investigating Censor Doulu You was demoted to Magistrate of Fushui; Investigating Censor Yang Hui was demoted to Magistrate of Badong—those implicated numbered several tens of people.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director of the Ministry of Revenue Zheng Zhang was demoted to assistant magistrate of Nanfeng; palace attendant Zheng Qinshuo to magistrate of Yelang; investigating censor Doulu You to magistrate of Fushui; investigating censor Yang Hui to magistrate of Badong. Dozens were implicated.

sentences.zh: 又敕嗣薛王琄夷陵郡員外別駕長任，其母隨男任；

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Heir of Prince of Xue Juan to serve in long appointment as Supernumerary Vice Prefect of Yiling Commandery, his mother following her son in his post;
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Heir of Prince of Xue Juan to serve indefinitely as supernumerary vice prefect of Yiling Commandery, his mother accompanying him.

sentences.zh: 女婿新貶巴陵太守盧幼林長流合浦郡。

translations.literal: the son-in-law, newly demoted Prefect of Baling Lu Youlin, was sentenced to long exile in Hepu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His son-in-law Lu Youlin, newly demoted from prefect of Baling, was sentenced to long exile in Hepu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 肅宗時為皇太子，恐懼上表，稱與新婦離絕。

translations.literal: Suzong was then Crown Prince; in fear he submitted a memorial, stating that he was separated from his new wife.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong, then crown prince, submitted a memorial in fear, stating that he was separated from his new wife.

sentences.zh: 七載，嗣薛王琄停，仍於夜郎郡安置，其母亦勒隨男。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Heir of Prince of Xue Juan was suspended, still being settled in Yelang Commandery; his mother was also ordered to follow her son.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Heir of Prince of Xue Juan was suspended and settled in Yelang Commandery; his mother was also ordered to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 堅貶黜後，林甫諷所司發使於江淮、東京緣河轉運使，恣求堅之罪以聞，因之綱典船夫溢於牢獄，郡縣征剝不止，鄰伍盡成裸形，死於公府，林甫死乃停。

translations.literal: After Jian's demotion and dismissal, Linfu prompted the responsible offices to dispatch envoys to the Jiang-Huai and Eastern Capital commissioners for transport along the Yellow River, seeking Jian's crimes at will to report; because of this transport overseers and boatmen overflowed the prisons, prefectures and counties extracted and scraped without cease, neighbors were all reduced to nakedness, and people died in the government offices—only when Linfu died did this stop.
translations.idiomatic: After Jian's fall, Linfu prompted officials to dispatch envoys to the Jiang-Huai and Eastern Capital transport offices along the Yellow River to hunt for crimes to report against Jian. Transport overseers and boatmen filled the prisons; prefectures and counties squeezed the people without cease; neighbors were stripped bare; many died in government custody. The persecution stopped only when Linfu died.

sentences.zh: 楊慎矜，隋煬帝玄孫也。

translations.literal: Yang Shenjin was a great-grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shenjin was a great-grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui.

sentences.zh: 曾祖隋齊王暕，祖正道，大業末，隨宇文化及至河北，為竇建德所破，因與其祖母蕭皇后入於建德軍，建德送於突厥處羅可汗牙。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather was Prince of Qi Yang Jian of Sui; his grandfather was Zhengdao. At the end of the Daye era he followed Yuwen Huaji to Hebei, was defeated by Dou Jiande, and thereupon entered Jiande's army with his grandmother Empress Xiao; Jiande sent them to the camp of the Türk qaghan Chuluohou.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather was Sui Prince of Qi Yang Jian; his grandfather was Zhengdao. At the end of the Daye era he followed Yuwen Huaji to Hebei, was defeated by Dou Jiande, and entered Jiande's army with his grandmother Empress Xiao. Jiande sent them to the camp of the Türk qaghan Chuluohou.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，李靖擊破頡利可汗，胡酋康蘇密以蕭后及正道歸，授尚衣奉御。

translations.literal: In the early Zhenguan era Li Jing defeated Qaghan Jieli; the barbarian chieftain Kang Sumi returned Empress Xiao and Zhengdao, and he was appointed Attendant of Palace Attire.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhenguan era Li Jing defeated Qaghan Jieli. The barbarian chieftain Kang Sumi returned Empress Xiao and Zhengdao, and Zhengdao was appointed attendant of palace attire.

sentences.zh: 父隆禮，長安中天官郎中，神龍後，歷洛、梁、滑、汾、懷五州刺史，皆以清嚴能檢察人吏絕於欺隱聞。

translations.literal: His father Longli was Director in the Bureau of Personnel in Chang'an; after Shenlong he successively served as Prefect of Luo, Liang, Hua, Fen, and Huai— all renowned for severity and ability in inspecting officials and officers and absolutely refusing deception and concealment.
translations.idiomatic: His father Longli served as director in the Bureau of Personnel in Chang'an. After Shenlong he held successive prefectures—Luo, Liang, Hua, Fen, and Huai—and was known for strict, capable inspection that left officials no room for concealment.

sentences.zh: 景雲中，以名犯玄宗上字，改為崇禮。

translations.literal: In the Jingyun era, because his name violated a character in Xuanzong's personal name, it was changed to Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingyun era his name violated a character in Xuanzong's personal name and was changed to Chongli.

sentences.zh: 開元初，擢為太府少卿，雖錢帛充牣，丈尺間皆躬自省閱，時議以為前後為太府者無與為比。

translations.literal: In the early Kaiyuan era he was promoted to Vice Director of the Palace Storehouse; although money and silk filled the rooms, between every foot and inch he personally inspected—contemporary opinion held that among those who had served as directors of the palace storehouse before and after, none could compare.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kaiyuan era he was promoted to vice director of the palace storehouse. Though money and silk filled the rooms, he personally inspected every measure. Contemporary opinion held that no previous or later director of the palace storehouse could compare with him.

sentences.zh: 擢拜太府卿，加銀青光祿大夫，進封弘農郡公。

translations.literal: He was promoted and appointed Director of the Palace Storehouse, given the additional rank of Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Hongnong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director of the palace storehouse, given the additional rank of Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Hongnong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 在職二十年，公清如一。

translations.literal: In office for twenty years, he was public and pure as one.
translations.idiomatic: He held office for twenty years with unwavering integrity.

sentences.zh: 年九十餘，授戶部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: At more than ninety years of age he was appointed Minister of Revenue and retired.
translations.idiomatic: At more than ninety he was appointed minister of revenue and retired.

sentences.zh: 時太平且久，御府財物山積，以為經楊卿者無不精好，每歲勾剝省便出錢數百萬貫。

translations.literal: At the time peace had long endured, and the imperial storehouse's goods piled like mountains; it was thought that whatever passed through Director Yang was without exception refined and excellent, and each year several million strings in cash were scraped and saved.
translations.idiomatic: Peace had long endured and the imperial storehouse overflowed. Whatever passed through Director Yang was thought to be refined and excellent, and each year several million strings in cash were squeezed out in savings.

sentences.zh: 慎矜沈毅有材幹，任氣尚朋執。

translations.literal: Shenjin was deep, resolute, and possessed talent and capacity; he indulged his temperament and valued factional stubbornness.
translations.idiomatic: Shenjin was deep, resolute, and capable, but willful and fond of factional stubbornness.

sentences.zh: 初，為汝陽令，有能名。

translations.literal: At first he served as Magistrate of Ruyang and had a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as magistrate of Ruyang and earned a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 崇禮罷太府，玄宗訪其子堪委其父任者。

translations.literal: When Chongli left the palace storehouse, Xuanzong inquired which of his sons could be entrusted with his father's duties.
translations.idiomatic: When Chongli left the palace storehouse, Xuanzong asked which son could be entrusted with his father's duties.

sentences.zh: 宰臣以慎餘、慎矜，慎名三人皆勤恪清白有父風，而慎矜為其最，因拜監察御史，知太府出納。

translations.literal: Chief ministers said that Shenyu, Shenjin, and Shenming—all three were diligent, pure, and white, with their father's manner, and Shenjin was foremost among them; he was thereupon appointed Investigating Censor and put in charge of palace storehouse receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers said Shenyu, Shenjin, and Shenming were all diligent, upright, and like their father, with Shenjin foremost. He was appointed investigating censor and put in charge of palace storehouse receipts and disbursements.

sentences.zh: 慎餘先為司農丞，除太子舍人，監京倉。

translations.literal: Shenyu had earlier served as Assistant Director of Agriculture; he was appointed Crown Prince's Attendant and supervised the capital granary.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyu had earlier served as assistant director of agriculture. He was appointed crown prince's attendant and supervised the capital granary.

sentences.zh: 尋丁父憂。

translations.literal: Soon he entered mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: He soon entered mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 二十六年服闋，累遷侍御史，仍知太府出納。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when mourning ended, he was repeatedly promoted to Attending Censor and still put in charge of palace storehouse receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, when mourning ended, he was promoted to attending censor and again put in charge of palace storehouse receipts and disbursements.

sentences.zh: 慎名授大理評事，攝監察御史，充都含嘉倉出納使，甚承恩顧。

translations.literal: Shenming was appointed Reviewing Official of the Court of Judicial Review, additionally acting as Investigating Censor, and filled the post of Commissioner for Receipts and Disbursements of the Capital Hanjia Granary—greatly receiving imperial favor.
translations.idiomatic: Shenming was appointed reviewing official of the Court of Judicial Review, additionally acting as investigating censor, and served as commissioner for the capital Hanjia Granary—greatly favored by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 慎矜於諸州納物者有水漬傷破及色下者，皆令本州征折估錢，轉市輕貨，州縣征調，不絕於歲月矣。

translations.literal: For goods submitted from the various prefectures that had water damage, breakage, or inferior quality, Shenjin ordered the originating prefecture to levy compensatory appraisal money, convert it to purchase light goods—the prefectures' and counties' extractions and levies never ceased throughout the months and years.
translations.idiomatic: For tribute goods damaged by water, broken, or of inferior quality, Shenjin ordered the originating prefecture to levy compensatory appraisal money and convert it to light goods. Prefectures and counties extracted levies without cease, month after month.

sentences.zh: 在臺數年，又專知雜事，風格甚高。

translations.literal: At the Censorate for several years, he again exclusively handled miscellaneous affairs; his style was very lofty.
translations.idiomatic: After several years at the Censorate he again handled miscellaneous affairs exclusively; his bearing was very lofty.

sentences.zh: 時散騎常侍、陜郡太守韋堅兼御史中丞，為水陸漕運使，權傾宰相。

translations.literal: At the time Regular Attendant and Prefect of Shaan Commandery Wei Jian concurrently served as Vice Censor-in-Chief and as Commissioner of Water and Land Canal Transport—his authority rivaled the chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Regular Attendant and Prefect of Shaan Commandery Wei Jian concurrently served as vice censor-in-chief and commissioner of water and land canal transport—his authority rivaled the chief minister.

sentences.zh: 侍御史王鉷推堅獄，慎矜引身中立以候望，鉷恨之，林甫亦憾焉。

translations.literal: Attending Censor Wang Hong investigated Jian's case; Shenjin held himself neutral to watch and wait—Hong resented this, and Linfu also harbored resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Attending censor Wang Hong investigated Jian's case. Shenjin held himself neutral and waited; Hong resented this, and Linfu also bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 慎矜與鉷父瑨中外兄弟，鉷即表侄，少相狎，鉷入臺，慎矜為臺端，亦有推引。

translations.literal: Shenjin and Hong's father Jiao were brothers within and without the clan; Hong was his nephew by the female line—they had been intimate since youth. When Hong entered the Censorate, Shenjin as head of the Censorate also had promoted and recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Shenjin and Hong's father Jiao were cousins; Hong was his nephew by the female line. They had been close since youth, and when Hong entered the Censorate Shenjin, as its head, had promoted him.

sentences.zh: 及鉷遷中丞，雖與鉷同列，每呼為王鉷，鉷恃與林甫善，漸不平之。

translations.literal: When Hong was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief, although he was in the same rank as Hong, he always addressed him as Wang Hong; Hong, relying on his friendship with Linfu, gradually became displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When Hong rose to vice censor-in-chief, Shenjin still addressed him as "Wang Hong" though they sat at the same rank. Hong, relying on his ties to Linfu, grew resentful.

sentences.zh: 五載，慎矜遷戶部侍郎，中丞、使如故。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Shenjin was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue; his posts as vice censor-in-chief and commissioner remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Shenjin was transferred to vice minister of revenue while retaining his posts as vice censor-in-chief and commissioner.

sentences.zh: 林甫見慎矜受主恩，心嫉之，又知王鉷於慎矜有間，又誘而啖之，鉷乃伺其隙以陷之。

translations.literal: Linfu saw that Shenjin received the ruler's favor and envied him in his heart; he also knew that Wang Hong had a rift with Shenjin, and again tempted and fed him—Hong thereupon watched for an opening to trap him.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu envied Shenjin's imperial favor and, knowing Hong's rift with him, tempted Hong further. Hong then watched for a chance to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 慎矜奪鉷職田，背詈鉷，詆其母氏，鉷不堪其辱。

translations.literal: Shenjin seized Hong's official field allotment, cursed Hong behind his back, and slandered his mother's clan—Hong could not bear the insult.
translations.idiomatic: Shenjin seized Hong's official field allotment, cursed him behind his back, and slandered his mother's family. Hong could not endure the insult.

sentences.zh: 慎矜性疏快，素昵於鉷，嘗話讖書於鉷，又與還俗僧史敬忠遊處，敬忠有學業。

translations.literal: Shenjin's nature was open and quick; he had long been intimate with Hong and once discussed prognostication books with him; he also associated with the returned-to-lay-life monk Shi Jingzhong—Jingzhong had learning.
translations.idiomatic: Shenjin was open and forthright and had long been close to Hong; he once discussed prognostication books with him and also associated with the former monk Shi Jingzhong, a learned man.

sentences.zh: 鉷於林甫構成其罪，云慎矜是隋家子孫，心規克復隋室，故蓄異書，與兇人來往，而說國家休咎。

translations.literal: Hong, with Linfu, fabricated his crime, saying Shenjin was a descendant of the Sui house, his heart scheming to restore the Sui dynasty; therefore he stored strange books, associated with evil men, and spoke of the state's fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Hong, with Linfu, fabricated charges that Shenjin, as a Sui descendant, schemed to restore the Sui dynasty, kept forbidden books, consorted with dangerous men, and discussed the state's fortunes.

sentences.zh: 時十一月，玄宗在華清宮，林甫令人發之。

translations.literal: It was then the eleventh month; Xuanzong was at Huaqing Palace, and Linfu had people expose the matter.
translations.idiomatic: It was the eleventh month. Xuanzong was at Huaqing Palace, and Linfu had the matter exposed.

sentences.zh: 玄宗震怒，繋之於尚書省，詔刑部尚書蕭隱之、大理卿李道邃、少卿楊璹、侍御史楊釗、殿中侍御史盧鉉同鞫之；

translations.literal: Xuanzong was shaken with rage, imprisoned him in the Ministry of Revenue, and ordered Minister of Justice Xiao Yinshi, Chief Justice Li Daosui, Assistant Chief Justice Yang Fan, Attending Censor Yang Zhao, and Palace Attendant Lu Xuan jointly to interrogate him;
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong was enraged, imprisoned Shenjin in the Ministry of Revenue, and ordered Minister of Justice Xiao Yinshi, Chief Justice Li Daosui, Assistant Chief Justice Yang Fan, Attending Censor Yang Zhao, and Palace Attendant Lu Xuan to interrogate him jointly.

sentences.zh: 又使京兆士曹吉溫往東京收慎矜兄少府少監慎餘、弟洛陽令慎名等雜訊之；

translations.literal: He also sent Jingzhao Assistant Magistrate Ji Wen to the Eastern Capital to seize Shenjin's elder brother Vice Director of the Palace Storehouse Shenyu, his younger brother Magistrate of Luoyang Shenming, and others for mixed interrogation;
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Jingzhao assistant magistrate Ji Wen to the Eastern Capital to seize Shenjin's elder brother Shenyu, vice director of the palace storehouse, his younger brother Shenming, magistrate of Luoyang, and others for joint interrogation.

sentences.zh: 又令溫於汝州捕史敬忠獲之，便赴行在所。

translations.literal: He again ordered Wen to capture Shi Jingzhong at Ruzhou; once captured, he was sent straight to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Wen was also ordered to capture Shi Jingzhong at Ruzhou and send him directly to the traveling palace once taken.

sentences.zh: 先令盧鉉收太府少卿張瑄於會昌驛，繋而推之，瑄不肯答辯。

translations.literal: First Lu Xuan was ordered to seize Vice Director of the Palace Storehouse Zhang Xuan at Huichang Post Station, imprison him, and press him; Xuan refused to answer or argue.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xuan was first ordered to seize Vice Director of the Palace Storehouse Zhang Xuan at Huichang Post Station and press him under imprisonment. Xuan refused to answer.

sentences.zh: 鉉百端拷訊不得，乃令不良枷瑄，以手力絆其足，以木按其足間，其枷柄向前，挽其身長校數尺，腰細欲絕，眼鼻皆血出，謂之「驢駒拔撅」，瑄竟不肯答。

translations.literal: Xuan used every means to torture and interrogate without success; he thereupon ordered ruffians to cangue Xuan, had strong men bind his feet, pressed wood between his feet, the cangue pole forward, pulled his body and lengthened it by several feet, his waist thinning almost to breaking, blood coming from eyes and nose—this was called 'donkey-foal uprooting'—yet Xuan still refused to answer.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xuan tortured him by every means without success, then had ruffians cangue Xuan, bind his feet, and press wood between them while pulling his body forward several feet until his waist nearly snapped, blood streaming from eyes and nose—a method called 'donkey-foal uprooting.' Xuan still refused to answer.

sentences.zh: 又使鉉與御史崔器入城搜慎矜宅，無所得，拷其小妻韓珠團，乃在豎櫃上作一暗函盛讖書等，鉉於袖中出而納之，詬以示慎矜。

translations.literal: He again had Xuan and Censor Cui Qi enter the city to search Shenjin's residence; nothing was found. They tortured his junior wife Han Zhutuan; it turned out that on a vertical cabinet she had made a hidden compartment holding prognostication books and the like. Xuan produced them from his sleeve, placed them in, and reviled and showed them to Shenjin.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xuan and Censor Cui Qi searched Shenjin's residence and found nothing. They tortured his junior wife Han Zhutuan and discovered a hidden compartment in a vertical cabinet holding prognostication books. Lu Xuan produced them from his sleeve, placed them inside, and flung them before Shenjin.

sentences.zh: 慎矜曰：「他日不見，今乃來，是命也。

translations.literal: Shenjin said: "Other days it was not seen; now it has come—it is fate.
translations.idiomatic: Shenjin said, "Before it was not seen; now it appears—it is fate.

sentences.zh: 吾死也。」

translations.literal: I shall die."
translations.idiomatic: I shall die."

sentences.zh: 及溫以敬忠至戲水驛東十餘里，使證說之：「若至溫湯，即求首陳不可得矣。」

translations.literal: When Wen brought Jingzhong to more than ten li east of Xishui Post Station, he had him testify and speak: 'If you reach the hot springs, then seeking to confess first will be impossible.'"
translations.idiomatic: When Ji Wen brought Jingzhong to a place more than ten li east of Xishui Post Station, he told him, 'If you reach the hot springs, it will be too late to confess first.'"

sentences.zh: 去溫湯十餘里，敬忠乞紙筆於桑樹下具吐之。

translations.literal: More than ten li from the hot springs, Jingzhong begged for paper and brush under a mulberry tree and fully confessed.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten li from the hot springs, Jingzhong begged for paper and brush under a mulberry tree and confessed fully.

sentences.zh: 比見慎矜，敬忠證之，慎矜皆引實。

translations.literal: When he met Shenjin, Jingzhong testified against him; Shenjin acknowledged everything as true.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingzhong confronted Shenjin, he testified against him, and Shenjin acknowledged everything.

sentences.zh: 二十五日，詔楊慎矜、慎餘、慎名並賜自盡；

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day an edict ordered Yang Shenjin, Shenyu, and Shenming all granted self-extermination;
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth day an edict ordered Yang Shenjin, Shenyu, and Shenming all granted permission to kill themselves.

sentences.zh: 史敬忠決重杖一百；

translations.literal: Shi Jingzhong sentenced to one hundred heavy blows;
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingzhong was sentenced to one hundred heavy blows.

sentences.zh: 鮮于賁、范滔並決重杖，配流遠郡；

translations.literal: Xianyu Fen and Fan Tao both sentenced to heavy blows and exiled to distant commanderies;
translations.idiomatic: Xianyu Fen and Fan Tao were both sentenced to heavy blows and exiled to distant commanderies.

sentences.zh: 慎矜外甥前通事舍人辛景湊決杖配流。

translations.literal: Shenjin's nephew, former Attendant of Affairs Master Xin Jingcou, sentenced to blows and exile.
translations.idiomatic: Shenjin's nephew, former attendant of affairs master Xin Jingcou, was sentenced to blows and exile.

sentences.zh: 義陽郡司馬、嗣虢王巨與敬忠相識，解官於南賓郡安置；

translations.literal: Acting Military Administrator of Yiyang Commandery and Heir of Prince of Guo Ju, who knew Jingzhong, was dismissed from office and settled in Nanbin Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Ju, heir of Prince of Guo and acting military administrator of Yiyang Commandery, who knew Jingzhong, was dismissed and settled in Nanbin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 太府少卿張瑄決六十，長流嶺南臨封郡，亦死於流所。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Palace Storehouse Zhang Xuan sentenced to sixty blows, long exile in Linchuan Commandery in Lingnan—he also died in the place of exile.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director of the palace storehouse Zhang Xuan was sentenced to sixty blows and long exile in Linchuan Commandery in Lingnan; he too died in exile.

sentences.zh: 慎矜兄弟並史敬忠莊宅官收，以男女配流嶺南諸郡；

translations.literal: The Shenjin brothers' and Shi Jingzhong's estates and residences were confiscated by officials; men and women were exiled to various commanderies in Lingnan;
translations.idiomatic: The Shenjin brothers' and Shi Jingzhong's estates were confiscated; their men and women were exiled to various commanderies in Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 其張瑄、万俟承暉、鮮于賁等準此配流。

translations.literal: Zhang Xuan, Wanqi Chenghui, Xianyu Fen, and others were exiled according to this standard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan, Wanqi Chenghui, Xianyu Fen, and others were exiled on the same terms.

sentences.zh: 乃使臨察御史顏真卿送敕至東京，殿中侍御史崔寓引慎名，令河南法曹張萬頃宣敕示之。

translations.literal: An Investigating Censor Yan Zhenqing was then sent to deliver the edict to the Eastern Capital; Palace Attendant Cui Yu led out Shenming and had Henan Legal Officer Zhang Wanqing proclaim and show the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Yan Zhenqing was sent to deliver the edict to the Eastern Capital. Palace attendant Cui Yu brought out Shenming and had Henan legal officer Zhang Wanqing proclaim the edict.

sentences.zh: 慎名見慎矜賜自盡，初尚撫膺，及聞慎餘及身皆爾，遂止。

translations.literal: When Shenming saw that Shenjin was granted self-extermination, at first he still beat his breast; when he heard that Shenyu and he himself were likewise treated, he then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenming learned that Shenjin was granted self-extermination, he at first beat his breast. When he heard that Shenyu and he himself were treated the same way, he stopped.

sentences.zh: 及宣敕了，慎名曰：「今奉聖恩，不敢稽留晷刻，但以寡姊老年，請作數行書以別之。」

translations.literal: When the edict had been proclaimed, Shenming said: "Now receiving the sage grace, I dare not delay even a moment; but because my widowed elder sister is old, I request to write a few lines in parting."
translations.idiomatic: When the edict had been read, Shenming said, "Receiving the sage's grace, I dare not delay even a moment; but my widowed elder sister is old, and I ask to write a few lines in parting."

sentences.zh: 寓揖真卿，真卿許之。

translations.literal: Yu bowed to Zhenqing, and Zhenqing permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yu bowed to Yan Zhenqing, and Zhenqing permitted it.

sentences.zh: 慎名神色不變，入房中作書曰：「拙於謀運，不能靜退。

translations.literal: Shenming's expression did not change; entering the room he wrote: "Clumsy in plotting fortune, unable to retire quietly.
translations.idiomatic: Shenming's expression did not change. Entering the room he wrote, "Clumsy in plotting my course, unable to retire quietly.

sentences.zh: 兄弟並命，唯姊尚存，老年孤煢，何以堪此！」

translations.literal: Brothers all meet death; only my elder sister still lives—old age, alone and bereft, how can she bear this!"
translations.idiomatic: My brothers and I all meet death; only my elder sister remains. Old, alone, and bereft—how can she bear this!"

sentences.zh: 書後又數條事。

translations.literal: After the letter there were again several items.
translations.idiomatic: After the letter he added several more matters.

sentences.zh: 又宅中作一板池，池中魚一皆放之，遂縊而死。

translations.literal: Again in the residence he made a plank pool; all the fish in the pool he released, and thereupon hanged himself and died.
translations.idiomatic: He then made a plank pool in the residence, released every fish in it, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 監察御史平冽賫敕至大理寺，慎餘聞死，合掌指天而縊。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Ping Lie, bearing the edict, arrived at the Court of Judicial Review; when Shenyu heard of death, he joined his palms, pointed to Heaven, and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Ping Lie arrived at the Court of Judicial Review with the edict. When Shenyu heard he was condemned to death, he joined his palms, pointed to heaven, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 初，慎矜至溫湯，正食，忽見一鬼物長丈餘，硃衣冠幘，立於門扇後，慎矜叱之，良久不滅，以熱羹投之乃滅。

translations.literal: At first, when Shenjin reached the hot springs, while eating he suddenly saw a ghostly thing more than a zhang long, in vermilion hat and headcloth, standing behind the door panel; Shenjin shouted at it, and for a long time it did not vanish; he threw hot broth at it and only then it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenjin first reached the hot springs, while eating he suddenly saw a ghostly figure more than ten feet tall in vermilion hat and headcloth standing behind the door. Shenjin shouted at it; it did not vanish for a long time until he threw hot broth at it.

sentences.zh: 無何，下獄死。

translations.literal: Before long he was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was imprisoned and died.

sentences.zh: 兄弟甚友愛，事寡姊如母，皆偉儀形，風韻高朗，愛客喜飲，籍甚於時。

translations.literal: The brothers were very affectionate; they served their widowed elder sister as a mother. All had imposing stature, lofty bearing and bright demeanor, loved guests and enjoyed drinking—greatly renowned in their time.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers were deeply affectionate and treated their widowed elder sister as a mother. All were tall and imposing, with lofty bearing; they loved guests and wine and were greatly renowned in their day.

sentences.zh: 慎名嘗覽鏡，見其鬚面神彩，有過於人，覆鏡嘆惋曰：「吾兄弟三人，盡長六尺餘，有如此貌、如此材而見容當代以期全，難矣！

translations.literal: Shenming once looked in a mirror, saw the spirit and color of his beard and face surpassing other men, covered the mirror and sighed in regret, saying: "We three brothers are all more than six chi tall, with such appearance and such talent—yet to be tolerated in the present age in hope of preservation is difficult!
translations.idiomatic: Shenming once looked in a mirror, saw that the spirit in his beard and face surpassed other men, covered the mirror, and sighed, "We three brothers are all more than six feet tall, with such looks and such talent—yet to be tolerated in this age and hope to survive is hard!

sentences.zh: 何不使我少體弱耶？」

translations.literal: Why did Heaven not make me somewhat weaker in body?"
translations.idiomatic: Why did Heaven not make my body somewhat weaker?"

sentences.zh: 竟如其言。

translations.literal: In the end it was as he said.
translations.idiomatic: In the end it happened as he said.

sentences.zh: 王鉷，太原祁人也。

translations.literal: Wang Hong was a native of Qi in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hong came from Qi in Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 祖方翼，夏州都督，為時名將，生、瑨、珣、

translations.literal: His grandfather Fangyi was Protector-general of Xiazhou, a famous general of the time; he had Sheng, Jiao, and Xun.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Fangyi, protector-general of Xiazhou, was a famous general of the age. He had sons Sheng, Jiao, and Xun.

sentences.zh: 瑨，開元初並歷中書舍人。

translations.literal: Jiao, in the early Kaiyuan era both successively served as Drafting Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao, in the early Kaiyuan era, successively served as drafting secretary.

sentences.zh: 珣，兵部侍郎、秘書監。

translations.literal: Xun was Vice Minister of War and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xun served as vice minister of war and director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 鉷，即瑨之孽子，

translations.literal: Hong was Jiao's son born of a concubine.
translations.idiomatic: Hong was Jiao's son by a concubine.

sentences.zh: 為鄠縣尉、京兆尹稻田判官。

translations.literal: He served as Magistrate of Huo County and Assistant Official for Paddy Fields under the Prefect of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Huo County and assistant official for paddy fields under the prefect of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，再遷監察御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was again promoted to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was again promoted to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，累除戶部員外郎，常兼御史，

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was repeatedly promoted and removed to Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, regularly also serving as Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he rose to vice director of the Ministry of Revenue while regularly serving also as censor.

sentences.zh: 充京和市和糴使，遷戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He filled the post of Commissioner for Capital Market Purchase and Equitable Grain Purchase, and was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He served as commissioner for capital market purchase and equitable grain purchase, then was transferred to director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三載，長安令柳升以賄敗。

translations.literal: In the third year Magistrate of Chang'an Liu Sheng was ruined by bribery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Liu Sheng, magistrate of Chang'an, was ruined by bribery.

sentences.zh: 初，韓朝宗為京兆尹，引升為京令。

translations.literal: At first Han Chaozong served as Prefect of Jingzhao and introduced Sheng as Magistrate of the Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chaozong had served as prefect of Jingzhao and introduced Sheng as magistrate of the capital.

sentences.zh: 朝宗又於終南山下為茍家觜買山居，欲以避世亂。

translations.literal: Chaozong also at the foot of Mount Zhongnan bought mountain residence at Goujiazui, intending thereby to avoid the chaos of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozong also bought a mountain residence at Goujiazui below Mount Zhongnan, intending to escape future turmoil.

sentences.zh: 玄宗怒，敕鉷推之，朝宗自高平太守貶為吳興別駕。

translations.literal: Xuanzong was angry and ordered Hong to investigate; Chaozong was demoted from Prefect of Gaoping to Supernumerary Vice Prefect of Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong was angry and ordered Hong to investigate. Chaozong was demoted from prefect of Gaoping to supernumerary vice prefect of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 又加鉷長春宮使。

translations.literal: Hong was again additionally made Commissioner of Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Hong was additionally made commissioner of Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 四載，加勾戶口色役使，又遷御史中丞，兼充京畿采訪使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was additionally made Commissioner for Registering Households and Corvée Labor, again transferred to Vice Censor-in-Chief, and concurrently filled the post of Investigation Commissioner of the Capital Region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was additionally made commissioner for registering households and corvée labor, promoted again to vice censor-in-chief, and concurrently made investigation commissioner of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 五載，又為京畿、關內道黜陟使，又兼充關內采訪使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he again served as Promotion-and-Demotion Commissioner of the Capital Region and Guannei Circuit, and concurrently filled the post of Investigation Commissioner of Guannei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he also served as promotion-and-demotion commissioner of the capital region and Guannei Circuit and concurrently as investigation commissioner of Guannei.

sentences.zh: 時右相李林甫怙權用事。

translations.literal: At the time Right Chief Minister Li Linfu relied on power and handled affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Right Chief Minister Li Linfu wielded power and controlled affairs.

sentences.zh: 誌謀不利於東儲，以除不附己者，而鉷有吏幹，倚之轉深，以為己用。

translations.literal: He plotted what was not beneficial to the Eastern Storehouse, to remove those not attached to himself, and because Hong had administrative talent, he relied on him ever more deeply and made use of him.
translations.idiomatic: He plotted against the crown prince and removed those not loyal to him. Because Hong had administrative talent, Linfu relied on him ever more deeply and used him as his instrument.

sentences.zh: 既為戶口色役使，時有敕給百姓一年復。

translations.literal: Once he was Commissioner for Household Registration and Corvée Labor, at the time there was an edict granting the common people one year's exemption from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Once Hong was commissioner for household registration and corvée labor, an edict granted the people one year's exemption from corvée.

sentences.zh: 鉷即奏征其腳錢，廣張其數，又市輕貨，乃甚於不放。

translations.literal: Hong thereupon memorialized to levy their transport fees, broadly inflated the numbers, and again purchased light goods—it was even worse than not granting exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Hong memorialized to levy transport fees instead, inflated the numbers, and converted the proceeds to light goods—the burden was worse than if no exemption had been granted.

sentences.zh: 輸納物者有浸漬，折估皆下本郡徵納。

translations.literal: For goods submitted that had soaking damage, compensatory appraisal was all sent down to the originating commandery for collection.
translations.idiomatic: For tribute goods damaged by soaking, compensatory appraisal was charged back to the originating commandery.

sentences.zh: 又敕本郡高戶為租庸腳士，皆破其家產，彌年不了。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered wealthy households of the originating commandery to serve as transport corvée laborers for rent and corvée; all were ruined in household property, and for years it was not completed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered wealthy households of each commandery to serve as transport corvée laborers for rent and corvée duties. Families were ruined and the burden dragged on for years.

sentences.zh: 恣行割剝，以媚於時，人用嗟怨。

translations.literal: He wantonly carried out extraction and scraping to please the times; people sighed and resented.
translations.idiomatic: He wantonly squeezed the people to please the court, and popular resentment grew.

sentences.zh: 古制，天子六宮，皆有品秩高下，其俸物因有等差。

translations.literal: Ancient regulation: the Son of Heaven's six palaces all had ranks high and low, and their stipend goods therefore had gradations.
translations.idiomatic: By ancient regulation the Son of Heaven's six palaces all had ranks, and stipends varied accordingly.

sentences.zh: 唐法沿於周、隋，妃嬪宮官，位有尊卑，亦隨其品而給授，以供衣服鉛粉之費，以奉於宸極。

translations.literal: Tang law followed Zhou and Sui; consorts and palace officials had positions of honor and baseness, and likewise received grants according to rank, to supply the costs of clothing, lead, and powder, thereby serving the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Tang law followed Zhou and Sui. Consorts and palace officials held ranks of high and low and received grants accordingly to cover clothing and toiletries for service at court.

sentences.zh: 玄宗在位多載，妃御承恩多賞賜，不欲頻於左右藏取之。

translations.literal: Xuanzong had been on the throne for many years; consorts receiving favor received many rewards and grants, and he did not wish frequently to take from the Left and Right Storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong had reigned many years. Favored consorts received many rewards, and he did not wish to draw constantly from the palace storehouses.

sentences.zh: 鉷探旨意，歲進錢寶百億萬，便貯於內庫，以恣主恩錫賫。

translations.literal: Hong probed his intent; each year he presented money and treasures totaling billions and stored them in the inner treasury, thereby allowing the ruler's gracious bestowals at will.
translations.idiomatic: Hong divined his intent and each year presented billions in money and treasures for storage in the inner treasury, thereby supplying the emperor's lavish grants.

sentences.zh: 鉷云：「此是常年額外物，非徵稅物。」

translations.literal: Hong said: "These are annual extra items beyond the regular quota, not levied tax goods."
translations.idiomatic: Hong said, "These are annual surpluses beyond the regular quota, not levied tax goods."

sentences.zh: 玄宗以為鉷有富國之術，利於王用，益厚待之。

translations.literal: Xuanzong thought Hong had methods to enrich the state, beneficial to the king's use, and treated him ever more generously.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong thought Hong had methods to enrich the state and treated him ever more generously.

sentences.zh: 丁嫡母憂，起復舊職，使如故。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his principal mother; recalled to his old post, his commissioner posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered mourning for his principal mother he was recalled from mourning to his old posts, his commissioner duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 七載，又加檢察內作事，遷戶部侍郎，仍兼御史中丞，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was again additionally made Inspector of Inner Construction Affairs, transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue, still concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief, and granted the purple-gold fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was additionally made inspector of inner construction affairs, promoted to vice minister of revenue while retaining the vice censor-in-chief post, and granted the purple-gold fish bag.

sentences.zh: 八載，兼充閑廄使及苑內營田五坊宮苑等使、隴右群牧都支度營田使，餘並如故。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he concurrently filled the posts of Commissioner of the Free Stable and Commissioner of Palace Farm, Five Wards, and Palace Park within the Park, and Chief Commissioner of Pasturage, Expenditure, and Farm Settlement in Longyou—all others as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he concurrently held the posts of commissioner of the free stable, commissioner of palace farms, five wards, and palace parks, and chief commissioner of pasturage, expenditure, and farm settlement in Longyou—all other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 太白山人李渾言於金星洞見老人，云有玉版石記符，聖上長生久視。

translations.literal: Mount Taibai recluse Li Hun spoke of seeing an old man in Jinxing Cave, saying there was a jade-plaque stone inscription talisman by which the sage ruler would enjoy long life and long sight.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hun, a recluse of Mount Taibai, said he had seen an old man in Jinxing Cave who spoke of a jade-plaque stone inscription talisman promising the sage ruler long life.

sentences.zh: 玄宗令鉷入山洞求而得之。

translations.literal: Xuanzong ordered Hong to enter the mountain cave to seek it and obtained it.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong ordered Hong to enter the cave to seek it, and he obtained it.

sentences.zh: 因上尊號，加鉷銀青光祿大夫、都知總監及栽接等使。

translations.literal: Thereupon the exalted title was submitted; Hong was additionally given Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace and Commissioner General of Supervision and Grafting and other posts.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon a exalted title was submitted, and Hong was additionally given the rank of Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of the Palace and the post of commissioner general of supervision and grafting.

sentences.zh: 九載五月，兼京兆尹，使並如故。
